content.text: I’ve got the full review payload. There aren’t any top-level issue comments; the only actionable feedback is three Copilot inline comments in `stats_render.go` and `stats_tui.go`. I’m checking the referenced code so I can tell you whether these look real or noisy.

PR `#999` has comments, but only from `copilot-pull-request-reviewer`. I found no top-level discussion comments and no human review comments yet.

The actionable inline comments are:

- [cmd/entire/cli/stats_render.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/stats_render.go:277): the month-axis loop does `d += len(month)/max(colWidth, 1) - 1`, which can go negative on very wide terminals and misalign the chart. This looks like a real bug.
  Discussion: https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/999#discussion_r3119591256

- [cmd/entire/cli/stats_render.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/stats_render.go:673): commit message truncation uses byte length and byte slicing, so non-ASCII commit messages can break alignment or split UTF-8. This is a real edge case, lower severity unless you care about Unicode-safe rendering.
  Discussion: https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/999#discussion_r3119591335

- [cmd/entire/cli/stats_tui.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/stats_tui.go:243): `newStatsStylesWithWidth` hardcodes `colorEnabled: true`, so `NO_COLOR` is ignored in the stats TUI. This also looks valid.
  Discussion: https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/999#discussion_r3119591362

If you want, I can fix these three now and reply to the review threads.

Fixed the three PR comments without replying on GitHub.

I updated [stats_render.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/stats_render.go) to clamp the month-axis column advance so wide terminals don’t misalign the chart, and I switched commit-line width/truncation logic to display-width-aware handling so UTF-8 messages don’t get split or padded incorrectly. I also updated [stats_tui.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/stats_tui.go) so the interactive stats TUI respects `NO_COLOR` via the existing `shouldUseColor` logic instead of forcing ANSI styles.

I added focused regression coverage in [stats_render_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/stats_render_test.go) for the wide month axis, Unicode-safe commit rendering, and color disabling. Verified with:

```bash
go test ./cmd/entire/cli -run 'Test(RenderContributionChart_MonthAxisWideWidth|RenderCommitList_UnicodeMessageSafeTruncation|NewStatsStylesWithWidth_RespectsColorFlag|RunStatsTUI_NoColorStyleFlag|PadOrTruncate|RenderCommitList_NilCommitMessage|RenderContributionChart_Empty)'
```
